description: This Dart source file defines the AttendanceDatabaseSource class, providing a unified data layer for attendance-related operations in a Flutter frontend project. It implements remote API calls with fallback to local database operations for offline scenarios, supporting login, marking attendance, and retrieving daily and weekly reports.

classes.name: AttendanceDatabaseSource
classes.description: A singleton class providing methods for login, marking attendance, and retrieving attendance reports, handling both remote API interactions and local database fallback.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs user login via remote API or local fallback, returning user info and token.

methods.name: markAttendance
methods.description: Logs attendance either through remote API or local database, accepting attendance details.

methods.name: getDaily
methods.description: Retrieves daily attendance report from remote API or local database.

methods.name: getWeekly
methods.description: Retrieves weekly attendance report from remote API or local database.
